channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran whips singer Parastoo Ahmadi 74 times over YouTube concert
item.description: Iranian authorities have lashed singer Parastoo Ahmadi over a 2024 performance streamed live on YouTube.

item.title: Poll finds US voters want government to end Iran war regardless of terms
item.description: New survey finds that 55 percent of voters, including 80 percent of Democrats, want war brought to an end immediately.

item.title: Iran war live: Saudi-led coalition strikes Yemen’s Hodeidah port
item.description: The Saudi coalition says its forces targeted operational capabilities at Hodeidah port and hit sites in northern Yemen.

item.title: Russia's own figures show almost 500,000 deaths in war in Ukraine
item.description: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia.

item.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
item.description: Nearly 1,000 children are among those killed or injured by explosives left over from the conflict, figures show.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
item.description: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had been in the post for two months, is among seven Palestinians reportedly killed in Israeli strikes on Tuesday.

item.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
item.description: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

item.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
item.description: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.

item.title: My family died in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
item.description: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.
